WebResource.Name: ppmf_connectionrefs
WebResource.Description:
Environment-wide connection reference inventory page for the Power Platform Monitoring Framework (PPMF).
Displays all connection references in the current environment in a single view, showing assignment status (Assigned / Unassigned / Inactive), connector type, owner, solution membership, and the number of cloud flows that depend on each reference. Expanding a row reveals the full connection ID, description, and a list of every dependent flow with its active or inactive state.
Designed to surface the information needed before and after solution deployment. An unassigned connection reference causes every flow that depends on it to fail at runtime — this page makes it immediately clear which references are missing a connection and which flows are affected, without having to navigate into each solution individually.
Summary counters at the top of the page show the total number of references alongside a breakdown by status. A warning banner appears automatically when one or more references are unassigned. Results can be filtered by status, connector type, and solution.
Requires System Customizer or System Administrator role.
